summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] arm in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skips on legacy Windows at runtime), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only). Added lines were checked for the 88-character limit by hand since Black was not run. Note: set_window_title returns True under TERM=dumb even though control() drops output there, matching show_cursor.
